req.title: Redirect to arbitrary URL
req.statement: The system shall issue an HTTP 302 redirect to the URL given by the 'url' query parameter of /redirect-to.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to() handler reads 'url' from query args, sets status_code=302 by default, and writes the exact URL string into the Location header. To kill mutations we must: (1) assert status_code == 302 exactly, (2) assert Location header equals the exact supplied URL string, (3) test with a custom 3xx status_code to cover the boundary conditions (300, 399, 400), (4) test missing 'url' param (negative path / KeyError), (5) test a URL with special/unicode characters to verify UTF-8 encoding path, (6) test status_code boundary at 300 (inclusive lower), 399 (inclusive upper), 400 (exclusive upper) to catch off-by-one mutations on the range check.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_basic_302_with_exact_location
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_basic_302_with_exact_location():
    target_url = 'https://example.com'
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + target_url)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == target_url

test_redirect_to_basic_302_with_exact_location()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_exact_location_header_value_not_modified
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
URL contains path, query string, and fragment-like characters
expected: Location header equals the exact supplied URL string without modification
trace: R-HTTPBIN-024: Location == url (exact string match, not parsed/normalized)
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import urllib.parse
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_exact_location_header_value_not_modified():
    target_url = 'https://example.com/path?q=1'
    encoded = urllib.parse.quote(target_url, safe='')
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + encoded)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == target_url

test_redirect_to_exact_location_header_value_not_modified()

tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_location_header_present_and_non_empty():
    target_url = 'http://test.local/foo'
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=' + target_url)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location')
    assert location is not None
    assert location != ''
    assert location == target_url
